# Third-party runtime files

- `rapier/rapier.mjs` is the published ES module from `@dimforge/rapier3d-compat` 0.19.3. It embeds the WebAssembly runtime. Apache License 2.0, supplied in `rapier/LICENSE`. Source: https://github.com/dimforge/rapier.js
- `three/` contains the ES module build and OrbitControls from `three` 0.180.0. MIT license, supplied in `three/LICENSE`. Source: https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js

The files were extracted unmodified from the official npm archives, whose SHA-512 integrity values are:

```text
@dimforge/rapier3d-compat sha512-mMVdSj1PRTT108s9Swbu2GQOmHbn8kbJANRV5xfczL3s0T4vkgZAuoMRgvBzQcHanpKusbC0ZJj6z3mC3aj3vg==
three                   sha512-o+qycAMZrh+TsE01GqWUxUIKR1AL0S8pq7zDkYOQw8GqfX8b8VoCKYUoHbhiX5j+7hr8XsuHDVU6+gkQJQKg9w==
```
